title: Paired View (Wheel + 3D Dome/Sphere), Reader-Chart Binding, and OKLCH Theme Completeness
hypothesis: Pairing 2D projection views (ChartWheel or shadow compass) with an interactive 3D sphere/sky-dome with shared selection and flattening animation, alongside client-only reader-chart binding and derived OKLCH light-theme ink tokens, makes 3D astronomical projection legible while eliminating dark-only ink regressions.
null_baseline: Disconnected 2D-only SVG plates with hand-guessed light-theme color overrides and per-page re-entry of observer/birth coordinates.
success_bar: Paired 2D/3D component renders SSR-safe SVGs with shared selection and flatten transition in caelus-wheel and caelus-widgets; OKLCH light/dark token pairs pass WCAG AA contrast; live browser check confirms non-zero rendered SVG nodes across all instruments.
kill_criterion: If animated 3D flattening adds runtime dependencies, breaks SSR safety in caelus-wheel, or exceeds bundle-size budgets, keep static dual projection without animation.
